mapper.sql: select ac.id, ac.article_id, ac.uid, ac.parent_id, ac.comment_grade, ac.target_id, ac.target_uid, ac.comment_uid, ac.content, ac.type, ac.state, ac.create_time, ac.update_time, um.nickname as commentName, um.avatar as commentAvatar, um2.nickname as targetName, um2.avatar as targetAvatar, ai.article_title as articleName from b_article_comment as ac left join b_user_main as um on ac.comment_uid = um.uuid left join b_user_main as um2 on ac.target_uid = um2.uuid left join b_article_information as ai on ac.article_id = ai.id
